# Read in data and setup

Let's get the signatures that we want. If you want the details about how they were developed, see the notebook `14a_inflammatory monocytes_v_rest.Rmd`. 



::: {.cell}

:::



We'll also need to be converting back and forth from mouse and human genes. We'll use this dataframe that I generated from biomaRt previously to do so. 



::: {.cell}

:::



## Get TCGA data

I've downloaded all the TCGA from cBioPortal and extracted the `data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt` files for every study. Let's read those in. 



::: {.cell}

:::



Given that the monocyte signature is mouse-derived, I think it makes sense to restrict the genes considered to the human homologs of genes which were detected in the single cell analysis. We can pull those from the Seurat object. 



::: {.cell}
::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
[1] 18456
```
:::
:::



Looks like we've got about 18,456 genes to consider.
